discovery_scope: Every Python source module and public function/method in src/nabt, tools, integrations/grammar_db and integrations/inference_db is inventoried; test directories, caches and historical code snapshots are excluded. New helpers require review, not automatic classification as authority-bearing entries.
static_analysis_limit: Literal-True grant detection is a supplementary syntactic check, not general data-flow or program verification. Computed grants in new modules or newly declared public helpers are detected by inventory changes; changes to existing function bodies still require code review and executable denial/corruption tests.
